title: The Official Launch of Spyglass
summary: Spyglass has officially transitioned from beta, now fully available and equipped with robust features to elevate your workflow.

title: Seamless File Management & Dynamic Display
summary: Take full command of your content with our enhanced file management system, making it easier than ever to upload, organize, and visually tailor every file in your editor.

title: Introducing the Noeko Product Roadmap
summary: We've launched a brand new public roadmap page, making it easier than ever to track our latest developments, see what's coming next, and discover exciting features planned for the future.

title: Supercharged Checkboxes
summary: Effortlessly manage your tasks with our supercharged checkboxes, now easier to click, fully draggable, and beautifully updated for a modern experience.

title: Improved Collaboration Experience
summary: We've made it easier than ever to collaborate by enhancing editor awareness and streamlining real-time teamwork for a more productive experience.

title: Enhanced Sharing and Collaboration
summary: Seamlessly discover and collaborate on shared ideas and quests, making teamwork smoother and more connected.

title: Noeko is Now Open Source!
summary: Experience unparalleled control and transparency as Noeko's codebase is now open source, inviting you to directly shape its future.

title: Advanced Knowledge Map: Filter and Connect Your Ideas
summary: Uncover hidden connections and ignite new insights within your knowledge base by leveraging dynamic filters for tags, time, and shared items on your interactive map.

title: Advanced Search & Personalized Knowledge Collections
summary: Unlock the full potential of your knowledge base with advanced filtering, flexible sorting, and the ability to save personalized collections for quick access to exactly what you need.

title: Dynamic Note Layouts
summary: Experience a more intuitive way to organize and interact with your notes, featuring flexible layouts and dynamic content previews that adapt to your unique thought process.

title: Introducing Noeko Self-Hosted and Premium Features
summary: Prepare to elevate your experience with Noeko, as we launch powerful self-hosting capabilities and flexible premium plans tailored to your team's needs.

title: Elevate Your Visual Experience with New Themes
summary: Get ready for a refreshed visual experience with improved existing themes and a brand new collection to perfectly match your style.

title: Time-Sensitive Welcome Messages
summary: We're ensuring your homepage greets you correctly every time, delivering the perfect 'Good Morning,' 'Good Afternoon,' or 'Good Evening' based on your local time.

title: Efficient Tagged Item Management
summary: Effortlessly remove multiple items from a tag right from the tag view, empowering you to organize your content with unprecedented speed and simplicity.

title: Broader Content Integration
summary: Soon you can effortlessly incorporate a richer variety of content, such as YouTube videos, websites, and text files, to centralize all your essential information.
